title: Can’t delete or move old event
text: Our iPads and iPhone match. But this app won’t move or delete old events to match iPhone or iPad. Example Friday I cancelled and rescheduled my dr appointment for Monday. But I can’t move Friday’s event to Monday. Sure I can add the event manually to Monday. But the Friday appointment can’t move or be deleted. I’m so worried this app is missing events. I want to delete but we added events via the app that I have no idea if they will transfer or disappear from iPad and iPhone. This app is too complicated for its own good. And the “plan a date” prompt is infuriating as hubs has terminal cancer and I now am constantly reminded that there will be no more “dates.”

title: Good, needs a few improvements
text: hiya! I'm liking it so far and its helpful to have all of our calendars linked. i'd like more flexibility with work hours because my schedule is more the same, but every other week is a different set of days on and off.

title: Almost perfect, but lacking complete calendar/list integration
text: Really love the idea behind Cupla and can see it becoming the perfect shared-life app for couples. The main thing keeping it from feeling fully finished for me is deeper iCloud integration, especially true two-way editing with Apple Calendar and Apple Reminders so events and shared tasks can be managed from either app. I’d also really like the ability to hide a single event from Cupla when it comes from an external/subscribed calendar, without having to hide the entire calendar. With those additions, Cupla would be exactly what I’m looking for.

title: It’s awesome, keep improving
text: This an amazing idea, i hope it’s being expanded on. Me and spouse are referring to the calendar on here a lot. Keep improving the product Cupla team :)

title: Paywall
text:
I used this app a couple years ago and thought it was great. Now I need to pay a subscription for even the most basic functions of a calendar. Like viewing more than a week in advance…

I understand the need to make money to pay workers, but basic calander functionality shouldn’t be locked behind subscriptions. If anything, the extra features that aren’t intrinsic to a calendar should be locked.  Like the to-dos, wishlist, etc. 

Think you guys forgot that people want a calendar first, not second

title: Unresolved Issue
text: I would give this at least 4 stars but I can’t because we are about to drop this app and start over with a different couples app. My wife is on it with me and she has had issues, on her calendar it does not show the numerical date after like the 8th. I’m paying for the app and we can’t even use it. I sent a few emails and have had no resolution. Also when I open the app to go into the timeline sometimes it isn’t there, sometimes I have to have the app open for like 5 minutes before I can open the timeline.

title: Shameful Promotions
text: Trying to make me by subscriptions is insane. Dumb app.

title: Only has by hour calendar
text: Tried the app to see if it has by hour and by monthly calendar. Only option is by hour without paying money. Tried deleting my account, account deleting does not work. Bad service.

title: Free version is worthless
text: Don’t waste your time on the free version. While paid versions of apps are always better, the limited 7-day view on the free version doesn’t provide any value.

title: Too much clutter
text: Too many spam/ad type notifications. Something meant to simplify is creating much more noise than it rightfully should

title: Cumbersome
text: Download the app and invite my partner, but my partner did not receive an email to confirm in her email: she appeared to be connected, but she could not access the calendar. Not user-friendly very confusing.

title: Not worth
text: Was looking for something a little simpler than Google Calendar but the free version of this app doesn’t allow you to view calendars for the whole month, only for a week

title: Buggy
text: There seems to be a bug in the app— there are certain months in the calendar that I can’t add dates (Sept 2027, Nov 2027, Dec 2027) which kind of defeats the purpose of needing the app. If it doesn’t resolve in a few days I will likely cancel. Big oversight.

title: Don’t download this
text: Makes you pay money to see a full month view. What bs.

title: Lost functionality hurts the cupla app
text: They made it impossible to add an item without going through their AI agent. Should have made that an option. This really was frustrating

title: Sigh
text: Of course! There’s no way to disable the new, annoying AI assistant. And yes, it makes your entire bottom options bar uneven with its ugly eye-roll-inducing diamond button. Classic. (If there *is* a way to disable it, it’s conveniently impossible to find. Hm, I wonder why)

title: Has Everything A Couple Needs!
text:
Great app but somehow dates are missing on key events page when marked as Key Date on iOS 26 and above. iOS 18 is fine.

I wish there was an option to Skip overdue tasks that are set on repeat like for example a workout

Popup asking if I wanna change the photo for all or just today’s repeating event

title: Only reason I haven’t deleted it is because it’s convenient
text: My girlfriend and I use this app so she can see what times I am working. It’s a decent app, very consistent notifications, pushing you in multiple directions to buy the subscription. But that’s not why I’m writing this review. They implemented AI to essentially plan date nights for you and your partner. This takes away the human creativity and thoughtfulness that goes into planning dates. We don’t want ai

title: AI 👎🏻
text: I was really disappointed to see that Cupla has followed the trend of adding unnecessary AI chat bots to their app. AI is horrible for the environment, and the data centers that fuel AI is polluting & ruining local communities. Adding a COMPLETELY UNNECESSARY AI chat bot is gross. I’ll be looking for a different app.

title: Subscription?
text: god forbid something is free these days, do you really need to pay $35 a year to view a month?

title: Still have things to fix
text: Love the idea and the possibilities. Deleted bc we can’t get pictures to share to each other with our events.

title: have to pay
text: you have to pay to see more than 7 days of your partners calendar… kinda defeats the purpose

title: Have to pay to share
text: Have to pay for premium subscription in order to share calendars with family. No free version to share calendars. Don’t download if looking for a free calendar sharing app option! Edit due to developer response: it is very clear that it’s made for your partner only. I was only trying to add them (my partner is my family) but it was requiring a premium subscription in order to do so. Thus, I don’t think my rating is harsh in that you have to pay for the basic uses of this app.

title: Error, something went wrong, please try again
text: I updated the app and keep getting this message, this app is now useless

title: Pls fix the glitch
text: Great app, super glitchy, not super pretty.

title: If your relationship isn’t going well this might be the nail in the coffin
text: It’s like putting a magnifying glass on what’s not working with your relationship. It’d be nice to have some advice help or something if every time you try to set up a date it doesn’t happen.

title: Money grab
text: In theory this is a great app to stay connected with your significant other, where both parties can add dates and events to each other’s calendar. However, once you download the app you are bombarded with subscription plans and locked features. One of these features is seeing the other’s calendar. You can download the app, set up your calendar and plan dates but your partner can’t see the events you make and you can’t see the events they make. Unbelievable that they do not explain this in the App Store and require you to pay for a subscription in order to use the base features. Very dissatisfied

title: Subscription Gatekeeping at its Finest
text: Platform seems good, if you could use any of the features without getting bombarded with subscription requests. You can only see events in the next 7 days without paying. They have subscription pop ups everywhere begging for every cent. Nothing more infuriating than getting bombarded over and over to pay money for a simple app that provides nothing more than convenience. Make your money on M&A, awareness branding, funding rounds, exposure, etc. not the consumer!!

title: Good concept but cost too much.
text: It’s a good concept but without paying you can’t actually see your partners events. I got it so I could see his work schedule and I can’t even do that.

title: Zero Chat
text: This app is really great. There is zero difference between the free and the paid version. It says that there’s a chat feature and you can share photos, but they are absolutely is no chat feature with any version. So it just looks like I wasted $40.

title: Needs to be updated
text: App and widgets were great until the latest app update…. Now the widgets are just whited out.

title: Some difficulties
text: This app is really easy to set up and convenient to set up. My only issue is that if you do not pay, you actually can’t see your partners schedule. I will add events that my significant other has planned, but once I add them, they disappear for me. So that aspect makes things trickier and almost forces you to pay if you want to be organised. Otherwise you will have to work your way around that.

title: Can’t get the widget
text: When j first got this app months ago I was able to have the widget, I am a very visual person. Now my widget deleted itself and I CANNOT download a new widget to my Home Screen no matter what I do. I can’t believe I paid for this and now I can’t use it for its intended purpose. Really annoying

title: Horrible
text: Impossible to edit, crazy aggressive about subscriptions and access to other calendars and contact lists.

title: Mobile app is great - Mac App not so much
text: I was surprised that the app for MacOs is nothing more than a TINY screen duplicate of the phone screen  - its pretty much useless to me as I am working on a 32” monitor the app is 2 x 4” and I cannot even see it LOL    The app designer **REALLY** needs to make this more functional if they want people to be able to use it on computers.   I will stick to Google Calendar for now..

title: Pay to see others calendar
text: Downloaded the app so I could share a work calendar with my parented while he was away for work and got through registration only to find out that you have tn pay to see the other persons calendar. Not very cool for those who are on a budget and can’t afford to add another subscription to their list.

title: Can’t delete old events once synced
text: I like the idea but seems like it still needs more work on since I had already synced some events from google but had to cancel events it still showed on Cupla. How do I delete events synced from my Google Calendar thats no longer needed on Cupla…. Once its synced it stays

title: Money hog
text: This app requires any money for it to be able to actually work it’s a shared calendar that you can’t see the other persons events unless you pay for it? Kinda dumb.

title: Twice my calendar has disappeared
text: I loved this app but after I split with my husband I wanted to keep using it. The calendar and to-do list features were very cool. Unfortunately it kept deleting my calendar. I had to call the first time, which was a hassle and then I simply deleted the app. It’s unfortunate because people break up all the time and you should be able to keep using your schedule.
